protocol.registration: fixed before this supplementary generation; introduced after the main experiment plan
protocol.status_scope: supplementary diagnostic, not a new preregistered confirmatory claim
protocol.matching: Per query and rank slot: trim both captions to their shared minimum whitespace-word count. Keep original owner IDs, ranking and metadata. No padding or extra descriptions.
protocol.training_memory: Retrieval-aware and noise adapters were trained with the full training memory. This control changes only inference memory and does not retrain adapters.
limitations: Trimming can remove semantic details or end a sentence mid-phrase.
Only the first configured seed and the fixed diagnostic image subset are assessed.
Changing bank size changes retrieved content; results are conditional effects of these banks, not isolated effects of memory capacity in all settings.
